html:
Join Vietlook Overview of Hoi An with its famous landscapes, cultures, culinary quintessence and unique festivals, which will surely bring visitors the most memorable vacation.

Hoi An used to be a bustling international trading port, and includes its own unique architectural heritage, along with many famous landmarks such as: Chua Cau, An Bang beach, Hoi An market, Phuoc Kien Assembly Hall… Not only that, this place has also been recognized by UNESCO as a world cultural heritage since 1999.

Hoi An city is located on the poetic Thu Bon river, a place with a poetic beauty, coming here visitors can stroll to admire the beauty along the river, and take beautiful pictures in the old town.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Hoi An, visit the traditional craft village, here visitors will encounter occupations such as: carpentry, pottery making, vegetable growing, medicine, lantern making… not only bringing income to the people here but also attracting tourists to visit.

Kim Bong Carpentry Village

A place that still retains its quintessence, especially the craft of carving, wood carving, … until now the craft village still retains the quintessence of a traditional craft by talented artisans, creating sophisticated works that attract tourists to visit and learn about that quintessential culture.

Thanh Ha Pottery Village

Located about 1.5 km from Hoi An, this place is famous for ceramics, after so much time but the pottery village still preserves a traditional craft village, coming here visitors will experience pottery making, and listen to thrilling stories from the elders here.

Tra Que Vegetable Village

Located about 3 km from the center of Hoi An ancient town, but this place has its own beauty, coming here visitors will encounter a green vegetable field, very eye-catching care, each season is a different type of vegetable.

Phuoc Kieu Bronze Casting Village

If you have the opportunity to travel to Hoi An, walking along the road, you will see many products displayed that look very eye-catching, you can visit and buy them as souvenirs.

The Museum of History and Culture

It is a place that displays 212 original artifacts and valuable documents made of ceramics, porcelain, bronze, iron, paper, wood… showing historical periods, when visiting, you will feel the historical culture…

Hoi An Cuisine:

Cao Lau

A famous dish of Quang Nam, and also a specialty of Hoi An, with chewy yellow noodles mixed with shrimp, char siu pork and various vegetables in the broth, creating a delicious and famous flavor.

Quang Noodles

A famous dish of Quang Nam, the noodles are made from rice flour, chewy noodles, served with basil, fresh lettuce, young cabbage, white bean sprouts, onions, banana flowers, pork, shrimp, chicken, snakehead fish… and broth, giving diners a rich flavor.

Crispy fried pancakes

A dish you must try when you have the opportunity to visit Hoi An, a very attractive dish that you can enjoy right at small restaurants or on the sidewalk, there is nothing more interesting than eating and enjoying.

Banh Canh With smooth white noodles, mixed with broth will bring diners an unforgettable rich flavor, the cake is eaten with roasted pork, fish cakes, raw vegetables, seafood, green chili and chili sauce to enhance the flavor.

Wet rice paper rolls with grilled meat
The cake is made very elaborately, especially the step of marinating with spices such as five-spice powder, onion, lemongrass, after making it, put it on a plate to cool, add a little sesame to keep the aroma of the cake for a long time…

if you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang – Hoi An, you should enjoy this dish to remember the delicious taste of the Central region forever.
